rationale: High cardinality categories suffer from curse of dimensionality in one-hot. Target encoding captures predictive mean while smoothing prevents leakage and overfitting on rare levels.

rationale: Financial and weight features often follow log-normal distributions. Tree models split on quantiles, but log-transform linearizes variance making boundaries clearer for leaf assignment.
